control.description-key: Composite Funding tab for a Requirement. Sticky FY picker drives a Requirement Details (rank) section, a read-only Requirement Fundings list, a Funding by Prioritizations grid, and a Funding by Requirement Details grid. Sections show/hide based on whether the Requirement has Prioritizations and/or Requirement Details. Bind to any text field on book_requirements (e.g. book_name) — the bound value is ignored.

property.name: hostField
property.description-key: Bound text field on book_requirements (value is ignored).
